name: Spoof-proof satellite time signal
subtitle: clock signals from space that cannot be faked

effects.effect: measuring one entangled particle instantly fixes its partner's state, and any snooping shows

effect: measuring one entangled particle instantly fixes its partner's state, and any snooping shows
how: Power grids, phone networks and stock exchanges all set their clocks by GPS, whose signals can be faked with a cheap transmitter. A satellite sends one photon of each entangled pair to each of two ground stations, and comparing when partner photons arrived lets the stations set their clocks to each other; forged or delayed photons break the pairs' tell-tale link, so tampering shows at once.
obstacle: Entangled photons arrive only a few at a time, and daylight and clouds swamp them.
why: Quantum-secured time transfer shown over short fibres; no satellite time service exists.
real: Micius did satellite quantum-secure time transfer via two-way QKD (not entangled pairs) and entanglement time transfer is shown only over 2 km links; no entanglement-based satellite clock sync.
